skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles of private international law in civil and commercial relations involving foreign elements.
Comprehend and apply civil law principles in international contexts.
Conduct independent legal research on international law issues.
Provide legal advice on international civil and commercial relations.
Analyze and resolve conflicts of laws in international settings.
Understand and apply international civil procedure rules.
Understand and apply principles of international arbitration.
Apply property law principles in international contexts.
Write legal documents and reports on international law topics.
Analyze and critically evaluate legal issues in international contexts.
Effectively communicate legal concepts and advice in international settings.
Collaborate effectively in group presentations and discussions on international law topics.
